name: Ajvar Bruschetta
reasons: Technique fried -> removed (no matching preparation category); follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Slice rustic bread and toast until golden and crispy.
Rub each slice lightly with a raw garlic clove.
Spread ajvar generously on each slice.
Drizzle with olive oil and scatter fresh chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

name: Apple Pie
reasons: 60 min pastry chill + up to 60 min baking + 120 min cooling; retain 20 min active preparation.

steps.display_text: Make pastry: combine flour and cold butter until crumbly. Add ice water tablespoon by tablespoon until dough comes together. Refrigerate 1 hour.
Peel and slice apples. Toss with sugar, cinnamon, flour, and lemon juice.
Roll out half the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish. Add apple filling, mound it high.
Roll second piece of pastry. Cover pie, crimp edges, and cut steam vents.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, then reduce to 175°C for 35–40 minutes until golden and bubbling. Cool 2 hours before slicing.

name: Avocado Toast
reasons: Technique fried -> removed (no matching preparation category); follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crispy.
Halve avocado, remove pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Leave slightly chunky.
Spread avocado generously on toast. Finish with chili flakes, flaky sea salt, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: BBQ Ribs
reasons: Technique pan_fry -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs.
Mix dry rub: paprika, garlic powder, brown sugar, salt, pepper, and mustard. Coat ribs generously. Refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 150°C. Wrap ribs tightly in foil and bake for 2.5–3 hours until very tender.
Open foil, brush ribs with BBQ sauce.
Grill or broil for 5–10 minutes until sauce is sticky and caramelised.
Rest 5 minutes. Cut between bones and serve with coleslaw.

name: BLT Sandwich
reasons: Technique raw -> pan_fry; follow the stored preparation steps. Cold assembled dishes use the existing raw category, which does not imply all ingredients are uncooked.

steps.display_text: Cook bacon in a dry pan until extra crispy. Drain on paper towels.
Toast bread until golden.
Spread mayo on both slices of toast.
Layer lettuce, tomato slices, and bacon. Season tomato with salt and pepper.
Press together, cut diagonally. Serve immediately.

name: Baked Chicken with Potatoes
reasons: Technique pan_fry -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Score chicken legs and rub with olive oil, garlic, paprika, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Cut potatoes into wedges and toss in olive oil with salt and herbs.
Preheat oven to 200°C. Arrange potatoes in a baking tray, place chicken on top.
Roast for 50–60 minutes, turning potatoes halfway, until chicken skin is crispy and golden.
Check chicken is cooked through (juices run clear). Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Baked Trout
reasons: Technique grilled -> baked; follow the stored preparation steps, not the dish title.

steps.display_text: Score both sides of the fish with 3 diagonal cuts. Season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with lemon slices, garlic, and fresh herbs.
Drizzle with olive oil and place in a baking dish or on a sheet of foil.
Roast at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until skin is crispy and flesh flakes easily.
Serve with extra lemon wedges and a fresh green salad.

name: Baklava
reasons: Include the mandatory 120 min syrup absorption after baking.

steps.display_text: Make syrup: boil water, sugar, and honey for 5 minutes. Add rose water. Cool completely.
Roughly chop walnuts and mix with cinnamon and a little sugar.
Brush a baking tray with butter. Layer 6–8 filo sheets, brushing each with butter.
Spread walnut mixture evenly. Continue layering filo with butter on top.
Cut into diamonds all the way through before baking. Bake at 180°C for 35–40 minutes until golden.
Immediately pour cold syrup over hot baklava. Let absorb for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Blueberry Muffins
reasons: Remove the under-30 tag because corrected elapsed time exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.display_text: Preheat oven to 190°C. Line a muffin tin with paper cases.
Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, lemon zest.
Mix wet: eggs, buttermilk, melted butter, vanilla.
Fold wet into dry until just combined — a few lumps are fine. Do not over-mix.
Fold in blueberries gently. Fill cases to the brim. Sprinkle demerara sugar on top.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until tops are domed and a skewer comes out clean.
